programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: La electricidad de Mr. Bean se corta cuando la Sra. Wicket ve el costo de su factura de electricidad, por lo que construye una turbina eólica. Todo bien hasta que hay demasiado viento , que crea una oleada de electricidad y una gran conmoción para todos.

programme.title: Cuda inżynierii
programme.desc: Na całym świecie nie brakuje odważnych architektów z oryginalnymi wizjami. Aby je zrealizować często podejmują wielkie ryzyko, używając niesprawdzonych do końca materiałów czy nowatorskich rozwiązań.

programme.title: Top Gear 29

programme.title: Top Gear 13

programme.title: Cuda inżynierii kolejowej
programme.desc: Opowieść o najbardziej spektakularnych konstrukcjach i liniach kolejowych na świecie, które urzekają widza śmiałymi rozwiązaniami inżynieryjnymi. W XIX w. to właśnie kolej stanowiła najnowocześniejszą gałęź gospodarki. Konstruktorzy trakcji kolejowych bez lęku podbijali górskie szlaki, przekraczali rwące rzeki i zmieniali architektury miast, by zbudować solidne torowiska. W dokumencie przedstawione zostaną przełomowe wydarzenia w historii tej dziedziny transportu oraz sylwetki pionierów kolejnictwa, którzy często wbrew naturze i fizyce tworzyli cieszące oko konstrukcje.

W XIX w. to właśnie kolej stanowiła najnowocześniejszą gałęź gospodarki. programme.title: Jak powstaje samochód
programme.desc: Dokumentární série poskytující přístup do všech oblastí k podrobnému pohledu na postup, jak sestrojit některá z nejpůsobivějších automobilů na planetě. Tento seriál nám exkluzivně představí výrobce automobilů, kteří se v tomto průmyslovém odvětví nacházejí na světové špičce. Zveme vás na úžasnou exkurzi. Jednotlivé epizody dokumentují výrobu různých, dnes už ikonických modelů, a to od několika prvních šroubků až po finální výsledek. Tento seriál seznámí diváky se všemi fázemi a účastníky výrobního procesu, od konstruktérských týmů po odborné síly, které tyto legendární vozy dávají dohromady. Mimo to získáme informace o historii... prezentovaných automobilek a seznámíme se s prognózami ohledně jejich budoucího vývoje. Ať už půjde o luxusní Gr and Tour, nebo o černý taxík neodmyslitelný od londýnských ulic, poznáme, v čem tkví jejich unikátní charakter, a navíc na vlastní oči uvidíme, jak se vyrábějí.

programme.title: Warsztat samolotów wojskowych
programme.desc: Grupa inżynierów przywraca zabytkowym samolotom dawny blask. W warsztatach w całej Europie specjaliści zbudują zepsute części od nowa, naprawią uszkodzone elementy i obudzą uśpione od lat silniki.

programme.title: Jak powstaje samochód
programme.desc: Dokumentární série poskytující přístup do všech oblastí k podrobnému pohledu na postup, jak sestrojit některá z nejpůsobivějších automobilů na planetě. Tento seriál nám exkluzivně představí výrobce automobilů, kteří se v tomto průmyslovém odvětví nacházejí na světové špičce. Zveme vás na úžasnou exkurzi. Jednotlivé epizody dokumentují výrobu různých, dnes už ikonických modelů, a to od několika prvních šroubků až po finální výsledek. Tento seriál seznámí diváky se všemi fázemi a účastníky výrobního procesu, od konstruktérských týmů po odborné síly, které tyto legendární vozy dávají dohromady. Mimo to získáme informace o historii... prezentovaných automobilek a seznámíme se s prognózami ohledně jejich budoucího vývoje. Ať už půjde o luxusní Gr and Tour, nebo o černý taxík neodmyslitelný od londýnských ulic, poznáme, v čem tkví jejich unikátní charakter, a navíc na vlastní oči uvidíme, jak se vyrábějí.

programme.title: Warsztat samolotów wojskowych
programme.desc: Grupa inżynierów przywraca zabytkowym samolotom dawny blask. W warsztatach w całej Europie specjaliści zbudują zepsute części od nowa, naprawią uszkodzone elementy i obudzą uśpione od lat silniki.

programme.title: Allo, allo
programme.desc: Ve Francii během druhé světové války provozuje Rene Artois malou kavárnu, kde denně komunikují bojovníci odporu, muži gestapa, důstojníci německé armády a uprchlí spojenečtí váleční zajatci. Francouzská vesnice Nouvion, 1941: II. světová válka je v plném proudu a hlavní hrdina, kavárník Renné Artois, zažívá krušné chvíle. Mezi hosty jeho kavárny patří němečtí důstojníci, příslušníci gestapa, francouzští odbojáři i obyčejní vesničané. A Rennému z existenčních důvodů nezbývá, než se všemi znepřátelenými frakcemi spolupracovat. K tomu se ještě ze všech sil snaží, aby jeho manželka Edith nepřišla na jeho románek se servírkou Yvette, a aby Yvette nepřišla na to, že má současně pletky... s druhou servírkou, Marií. Odbojářka Michelle ¨Nebudu-to-víckrát-opakovat¨ Dubois v jeho kavárně uk rývá dva uprchlé britské letce, velitel města, plukovník von Strohm zase ukradený obraz Padlé Madony, který mu má po válce zajistit příjemnou penzi. Německý poručík Gruber se Rennému dvoří, senilní odbojářský padělatel LeClerc se pro změnu dvoří Renného protivné tchyni a aby toho nebylo málo, kavárnu často v přestrojení navštěvuje všemi obávaný Herr Flick z Gestapa. Nešťastný Renné tedy musí obratně kličkovat a lhát, aby se vůbec dožil konce války.

programme.title: Cuda inżynierii kolejowej
programme.desc: Opowieść o najbardziej spektakularnych konstrukcjach i liniach kolejowych na świecie, które urzekają widza śmiałymi rozwiązaniami inżynieryjnymi. W XIX w. to właśnie kolej stanowiła najnowocześniejszą gałęź gospodarki. Konstruktorzy trakcji kolejowych bez lęku podbijali górskie szlaki, przekraczali rwące rzeki i zmieniali architektury miast, by zbudować solidne torowiska. W dokumencie przedstawione zostaną przełomowe wydarzenia w historii tej dziedziny transportu oraz sylwetki pionierów kolejnictwa, którzy często wbrew naturze i fizyce tworzyli cieszące oko konstrukcje.

programme.title: Więźniarki
programme.desc: Dogłębne spojrzenie na codzienne życie kobiet osadzonych w amerykańskim więzieniu Western Massachusetts Regional Woman's Correctional Centre. Członkinie gangów, morderczynie, przemytniczki narkotyków, złodziejki - to tylko jedna strona ich osobowości. Za każdą z nich stoi przecież także inna rola - córki, matki, żony czy siostry. Twórcy pytają, jak radzą sobie one z życiem w zamknięciu, surowymi warunkami, trudnymi relacjami i niecodziennymi sytuacjami. Więzienna rzeczywistość narzuca przecież swoje brutalne zasady.

programme.title: Newsday
programme.desc: "Good Morning Asia, hello World." Join the news teams from BBC World News in London and Singapore. This live news and current affairs program is broadcast globally and focuses on all the latest news and breaking developing stories that matter around the world. The show is usually presented by Rico Hizon in Singapore and Kasia Madera in London. programme.title: Morning Live
programme.desc: Morning show discussing key topics of conversation of the previous week. The best start of Sunday: lively chat about social and religious issues, and highlights of extraordinary stories of ordinary people. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Crimewatch Live
programme.desc: Three-year-old Sandy Davidson disappeared from his grandmother's garden 50 years ago - do you know what happened? And how police jailed a controlling husband who drowned his wife in a hot tub.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Learn the tricks of the trade when you go to the auctions with Homes Under the Hammer. Join presenters Martin Roberts, Dion Dublin and Martel Maxwell as they follow the renovation stories of properties across Britain as they get transformed from empty shells and outdated buildings to desirable spaces and contemporary homes. Watch as ordinary people breathe new life into the otherwise unloved houses, and find out how well they managed to stay within budget. Will they sell and make a profit, or have they invested too much money in a project that wont sell? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Get ready for a "train-tastic" trip through the Bargain Hunt archives with Eric Knowles. This special show comes from Didcot Railway Centre in Oxfordshire, where Eric explores an array of artefacts, from wonderful whistles to lavish lanterns! He also recalls some railway-related buys from teams down the years and reveals some of the most profitable pieces sold at auction. Eric is joined by Sarah Jermyn from Didcot Railway Centre, who highlights some rare and unique items from Great Western Railway's long history. And if you're thinking of investing in some "railwayana" of your own, Eric has some tops tips that might be just the ticket! (Senderinfo).

programme.title: BBC News at One
programme.desc: The latest national and international news.

programme.title: BBC London
programme.desc: News, sport and weather from London.

programme.title: BBC News at One
programme.desc: Early afternoon round-up of the day's biggest national and international stories. The BBC News Team bring you the headlines and essential up-to-the-minute information about the latest developments. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Clean It, Fix It
programme.desc: Mark Wright and his team, Tommy Walsh and Maxine Dwyer, help Amanda and Dan make their dream home functional. Amanda, a hairstylist and singer, needs a proper space for both her salon and music room, while their daughter Evie needs storage in her room. The team reconfigure the multipurpose room, creating areas for work, music and storage. They clean and organise the salon, add soundproofing and transform Evie's room with new shelving. A stylish, functional home for the whole family! (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Shift the Thrift
programme.desc: In High Wycombe, mother and daughter Liz and Alice battle to raise money for Great Ormond Street Hospital, gambling on vintage fashion, ceramics and a bold sewing machine buy.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Push factors from the noisy, bustling cities of Britain, combined with the alluring peace of the countryside, has the population dreaming of homes in more scenic surroundings. Escape to the Country sees buyers from different areas on the UK considering their options to settle down in the English countryside. Presenters show off a range of prospective homes, before they must make their final decision towards the end of the show. Each episode taking place in a different region of the UK, we see a wide variety of beautiful homes across the country. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Sean and Francesca, both dedicated junior doctors with hectic schedules, are longing for a peaceful oasis to unwind in after their demanding shifts. Their dream garden is inspired by a journey to New Zealand. They would like to bring some of the NZ vibe to their new garden, creating a serene relaxation area incorporating ferns, grasses and raised beds, all brought together with a muted colour scheme. With a budget of £6,000, can designers Flo and Lee create a tranquil New Zealand-inspired paradise to give Sean and Fran the respite they deserve? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Join our host Ross Kemp in this suspenseful quiz, where contestants have to tread lightly in order to avoid "lies" on their way to the goal and the cash prize. The quiz tests the contestants' knowledge, but also how good they are in strategy and careful planning: stepping on the truths earns them money, while stepping on a lie means they lose half of their money, and if they step on three lies – they lose everything. Finding the right way has never been easy, but with a bit of luck they might not go back home empty-handed. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Pointless
programme.desc: Alexander Armstrong is joined by co-host Michael Ball. As always, contestants try to score as few points as possible by plumbing the depths of their general knowledge to come up with the answers no-one else could think of.

programme.title: The One Show
programme.desc: A show with big-name guests and special reports on a range of subjects including consumer rights, current affairs and contemporary issues. The One Show looks at topics from the quirky and rare to much more serious matters. Since first hitting British screens in 2006, The One Show has welcomed hundreds of celebrities to its sofa. With high-profile from stage, screen, sport, music, politics and more; including then-British-Prime Minister Theresa May, Daniel Radcliffe, Dame Judy Dench, Sir Tom Jones and many, many more. With fun, laughs and the occasional musical number. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: EastEnders
programme.desc: EastEnders is a series set in Albert Square in the East End of London in the fictional Borough of Walford. Here respectable townhouses are next to offices and apartments. We follow everyday stories of local residents and their families. The locals live their ordinary lives- go to night clubs, markets, pubs and cafes. They fall in love and fight, get sick, get divorced. Kids can break a window, neighbors can pick a fight. There is nothing extraordinary but life in the East End is full of various moments of fun. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: DIY SOS
programme.desc: Nick Knowles leads a team of experts whose mission is to transform the lives of people who are most at need of assistance. As a writer, he is the only member of the group who isn't a professional builder but that doesn't stop him getting his hands dirty and applying some elbow grease to the task in hand. The men and women who volunteer to apply their skills would be able to construct a house from scratch, but usually the task is confined to the business of fitting adaptations and devices that are required by people already in residence. It is no mean feat, where properties do not always lend themselves to simple renovation work. The viewers tune in to get some useful tips on house transformation, and see the techniques and insider tricks of the trade that make a seemingly impossible task achievable by the professionals. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bram Stoker's Dracula
programme.desc: Nach dem Tod seiner geliebten Elisabeta verflucht der rumänische Fürst Dracula (Gary Oldman) seinen Gott und wird zum Vampir. Gut 400 Jahre später lädt er Makler Harker (Keanu Reeves) auf sein Schloss. Dracula interessiert sich für Londoner Immobilien, vor allem aber für Harkers Braut: In Mina (Winona Ryder) erkennt er seine Frau wieder. Der Untote eilt nach England – kann Vampirjäger Van Helsing (Anthony Hopkins) ihn aufhalten?\n\nCoppola hielt sich eng an Bram Stokers Romanvorlage aus dem Jahr 1897, Kamerastar Michael Ballhaus verpasste dem viktorianischen Stoff den Look der 1990er-Jahre. Der sinnliche Bilderrausch erhielt drei Oscars für Kostüme, Make-up und Soundeffekte, eine weitere Nominierung für das Set-Design.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Learn the tricks of the trade when you go to the auctions with Homes Under the Hammer. Join presenters Martin Roberts, Dion Dublin and Martel Maxwell as they follow the renovation stories of properties across Britain as they get transformed from empty shells and outdated buildings to desirable spaces and contemporary homes. Watch as ordinary people breathe new life into the otherwise unloved houses, and find out how well they managed to stay within budget. Will they sell and make a profit, or have they invested too much money in a project that wont sell? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Christina is in the county famed for its ceramics to host another contest between two bargain-hunting teams. Staffordshire is also the birthplace of Wade Pottery and a postwar collecting phenomenon. From the 1950s onwards, Wade made Whimsies, small solid porcelain animal figures that are still collected today. Christina meets an avid collector who owns pieces worth hundreds of pounds. At Uttoxeter Racecourse, brothers Alistair and Dominic rummage for bargains with their expert Jonathan Pratt. They spot a huge leather megaphone but decide it isn't anything to shout about. Meanwhile, the blue team, mum and son Pam and Dan, are shopping with expert Irita Marriott when they spot a flambe ceramic cat, but the three-figure sum means it's too hot to handle. The question is, will the teams' items set Matthew Tong's saleroom on fire? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Clean It, Fix It
programme.desc: Mark Wright and his team, Maxine Dwyer and Asher Edwards, help single mum Alison transform her busy one-bedroom flat into a home that feels calm and organised. The space is overwhelmed by toys, limiting Alison's ability to cook, entertain and relax. Maxine declutters, deep-cleans and brightens the rooms, while Asher creates clever storage solutions alongside zones in the living room for dining and play. With a fresh coat of paint and new furniture, the team give Alison and her daughter a practical and inviting home. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Push factors from the noisy, bustling cities of Britain, combined with the alluring peace of the countryside, has the population dreaming of homes in more scenic surroundings. Escape to the Country sees buyers from different areas on the UK considering their options to settle down in the English countryside. Presenters show off a range of prospective homes, before they must make their final decision towards the end of the show. Each episode taking place in a different region of the UK, we see a wide variety of beautiful homes across the country. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Charlie Dimmock and brothers Harry and David Rich are challenged with producing garden designs for homeowners across the UK. Factoring in the available garden space and budget, the garden owner decides which design they want to bring to life, and the selected team gets to work. Dimmock, who grew to fame in Groundforce, a garden make-over show that first aired in 1997, must use all her experience if she wants to trump the Rich brothers. Harry and David, who have taken the gardening world by storm, producing gardens for the Chelsea Flower Show as well as a display for the French fashion giant Chanel, are hoping their innovative outlook will help persuade the homeowners. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Join our host Ross Kemp in this suspenseful quiz, where contestants have to tread lightly in order to avoid "lies" on their way to the goal and the cash prize. The quiz tests the contestants' knowledge, but also how good they are in strategy and careful planning: stepping on the truths earns them money, while stepping on a lie means they lose half of their money, and if they step on three lies – they lose everything. Finding the right way has never been easy, but with a bit of luck they might not go back home empty-handed. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Pointless

programme.title: The Repair Shop: Beyond the Barn
programme.desc: First into the barn are cousins Dave and Dom with an extraordinary handmade model fairground created by their grandfather James Manley. Built from memory over many years using salvaged materials, the intricate miniature recreates the travelling fairground life James left behind after choosing to marry outside his fairground family and being disowned as a result. Decades of storage have left rides damaged, wiring unsafe and key components missing.

programme.title: Who Do You Think You Are?
programme.desc: Comedian and presenter Joe Lycett manages to find humour everywhere, but apart from his Edwardian great grandad – a member of the Royal Antediluvian Order of the Buffaloes in Nottingham – Joe uncovers a darker family history. Joe finds out that his two-times-great grandfather Robert Wilkinson was a boy chimney sweep in the 1850s. Joining the Royal Marines, Robert travelled the world; but his involvement in razing villages in China following the Opium Wars leads to alcoholism and a breakdown. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: In-depth news and current affairs review of the main political and economic stories of the day, featuring robust interviews with senior government and opposition figures, business and union leaders, and analytical reports that delve behind the headlines. Regular presenters cross-examine studio guests on details of policies, priorities, actions and inactions, on a range of domestic UK and international topics. There are weekly features on the arts, sports and the world of technology, and editors are not afraid to venture into niche, specialist and exotic areas from space travel to animal psychology. If the BBC's flagship Radio 4 Today programme sets the early morning news agenda for the day, then its late-night TV equivalent often gives the people in power some sleepless nights. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Newscast
programme.desc: Join BBC journalists including political editor Laura Kuenssberg, Europe editor Katya Adler, Brussels correspondent Adam Fleming and political correspondent Chris Mason in their weekly podcast discussing all of the news stories that matter to the people of the United Kingdom. The journalists know all about the stories that they're talking about – they interview the most important people involved in the stories that feature in the news. They speak of their knowledge and understanding of the news in a way that is understandable for all. Laura is often in a car in the middle of a city where big politics stories are happening. Katya, Adam and Chris are usually in the studio. They regularly talk about Brexit and what is going to happen when the United Kingdom leaves the European Union. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: The latest news from the BBC,which is designed to inform you on current affairs. The BBC is aims to be a totally impartial public service broadcaster, and was established by Royal Charter. The BBC is funded by a licence fee paid by British households, and is regulated by Ofcom. They aim to create high-quality content, in order to inform and educate, but also entertain, their audience Millions of people from all over the world watch content produced by the BBC, and they are well respected as a media company. It was founded in 1922, with its headquarters in Westminster, London. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Newsday
programme.desc: "Good Morning Asia, hello World." Join the news teams from BBC World News in London and Singapore. This live news and current affairs program is broadcast globally and focuses on all the latest news and breaking developing stories that matter around the world. The show is usually presented by Rico Hizon in Singapore and Kasia Madera in London. Broadcasting live at midnight GMT on both BBC World News and the BBC News channel, the show is broadcast in the morning in Asia and therefore is marketed as a morning show for people watching around the country. The show is often followed by Asia Business Report live from Singapore which reports on all the latest economy and business figures from the country. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: BBC World News America
programme.desc: News presenter Katty Kay keeps you up to date with all the latest breaking news from America and the rest of the world on BBC World News America. This world renowned news and current affairs program has been recognised for its exceptional reporting at the Emmy Awards. BBC World News America won two Emmy awards for its coverage of the conflicts in Syria and the Central African Republic. You can catch up with this award winning broadcast team as they air multiple times a day throughout the week. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: In-depth news and current affairs review of the main political and economic stories of the day, featuring robust interviews with senior government and opposition figures, business and union leaders, and analytical reports that delve behind the headlines. Regular presenters cross-examine studio guests on details of policies, priorities, actions and inactions, on a range of domestic UK and international topics. There are weekly features on the arts, sports and the world of technology, and editors are not afraid to venture into niche, specialist and exotic areas from space travel to animal psychology. If the BBC's flagship Radio 4 Today programme sets the early morning news agenda for the day, then its late-night TV equivalent often gives the people in power some sleepless nights. (Senderinfo).

Niekto by si povedal, že sa konečne dožil pokoja. Opak je však pravdou. Hrajú: Paolo Villaggio, Anna Mazzamauro, Milena Vukotic, Neri Parenti, Gigi Reder. programme.title: Spletenec
programme.desc: Clive a Elsa sa špecializujú na prepájanie DNA rôznych zvieracích druhov a vytvárajú tak fantastické nové hybridy. Teraz sa chystajú vykonať experiment, ktorý by mohol spôsobiť revolúciu vo svete vedy a medicíny. Hrajú: Adrien Brody, Sarah Polley, David Hewlett, Delphine Chanéac., Réžia: Vincenzo Natali, (dráma/scifi/thriller/horor), Kanada/Francúzsko/USA, 2009, 103 min.

programme.title: Kukačky
programme.desc: Seriál Kukačky rozpráva príbeh mladého manželského páru, ktorý zistí, že ich syn nie je ich. Keď sa dozvedia, že došlo k zámene, musia sa rozhodnúť, čo urobia. Žiadne riešenie nie je dobré. Zámena detí na malom meste sa dotkne nielen rodín, ktorých sa to priamo týka, ale i ostatných obyvateľov. Hrajú: Marta Dancingerová, Marek Adamczyk, Viktor Sekanina, Sabina Remundová., Réžia: Biser A. Arichtev, (dráma/komédia), Česko, 2021, 52 min.

programme.title: Krimi Online - Tomáš Strémy
programme.desc: Odborník na trestné právo Tomáš Strémy - Ako trestať maloletých za brutálne činy? Útok 13-ročného žiaka ôsmeho ročníka ŽS v Staškove otvára opäť diskusiu o prípadnej trestnej zodpovednosti maloletých do 14 rokov v tých najzávažnejších skutkoch, akými sú napríklad úkladné či masové vraždy alebo terorizmus. A pomôže nám vôbec represia bez prevencie.

programme.title: Rok 1968: Bod zlomu
programme.desc: Tento dokumentárny seriál je presiaknutý ohnivosťou desaťročia - rozpráva o otrasných útržkoch týchto rokov, keď sa všetko zdalo možné, no ktorých dedičstvo je stále také polarizujúce. Čo zostalo po 50 rokoch z hnutia z roku 1968, ktoré obrátilo svet hore nohami? Od Berkley po Paríž, od Berlína po Mexiko a od Varšavy po Tokio je svet v roku 1968 poznačený mnohostrannými a simultánnymi súťažami vedenými novou generáciou.

programme.title: Puccini, moderný obraz ženy
programme.desc: Giacomo Puccini, jeho hrdinky, oslobodzujúci krok vpred v histórii stvárňovania žien na lyrickej scéne a čo prezrádzajú o vzťahoch medzi Puccinim a ženami. To je téma tohto dokumentu, živeného čerstvými výpoveďami najväčších pucciniovských sopranistiek súčasnosti a ich vystúpeniami v Royal Opera House, Viedenskej štátnej opere alebo na festivale v Aix-en-Provence; pomocou reenactment sekvencií natočených v umelcovej toskánskej vile; a početnými archívmi. K 100.

programme.title: Japonsko: koniec pacifizmu
programme.desc: Tvárou v tvár rastúcim hrozbám zo strany Ruska, Severnej Kórey a predovšetkým Číny sa Japonsko neuveriteľne rýchlo vyzbrojuje. Tento dokument objasňuje geopolitické otrasy v tichomorskej oblasti a históriu japonského pacifizmu od druhej svetovej vojny.

programme.desc: Bývalý trestný sudca, advokát Roman Benedikovič - Je doživotie skutočne doživotím? Je doživotný trest na Slovensku skutočným doživotím? Má výška trestu, prípadne hrozba trestu smrti, odstrašujúci efekt na zločincov najzávažnejších skutkov? Odrádza alebo naopak motivuje aktuálna hrozba doživotia páchateľov k sériovým vraždám? Téma pre dlhoročného trestného sudcu Romana Benedikoviča, ktorý je v súčasnosti advokátom.

Hrajú: Tomáš Töpfer, Kateřina Macháčková, Kateřina Kaira Hrachovcová, Petr Hradil., Réžia: Jaroslav Hanuš, (dráma/rodinný), Česko, 1995, 50 min.

programme.title: Cesta peklem
programme.desc: Skúsený kaskadér Petr Kvapil patrí k najlepším. S kolegami Pepinom, Zdeňkom a ďalšími plnia náročné a nebezpečné priania našich aj zahraničných režisérov. Chvíle voľna potom trávia s manželkou Helenou a predovšetkým s malým synom Kubíkom, o ktorého sa s láskou stará a ktorý nadšene sleduje jeho odvážne kúsky pred kamerou. Hrajú: Radoslav Brzobohatý, Petr Jákl st., Pavel Nový, Martin Dejdar., Réžia: Martin Hollý ml., (akčný/dráma/thriller), Česko, 1995, 85 min.

programme.title: Na lavici obžalovaných justícia

Hrajú: Jakub Špalek, Jakub Wehrenberg, Luděk Munzar, Petr Štěpánek., Réžia: Martin Hollý ml., (dráma/mysteriózny), Česko, 1998.

programme.title: Krimi Online - Marek Vagovič
programme.desc: Novinár Marek Vagovič - Zľahčujú aktéri sledovania novinárov svoju vinu? Ako to bolo skutočne so sledovaním novinárov z rokov 2016-2017? Na súde sa túto jeseň začal dlho očakávaný proces, ktorý odhaľuje, ako Marian Kočner a bývalý príslušník SIS Peter Tóth podľa obžaloby financovali a riadili sledovanie novinárov - medzi nimi aj zavraždeného Jána Kuciaka. Poškodení novinári hovoria o cielenom a bezprecedentnom vyhľadávaní špiny a ich diskreditácii.

programme.title: Objavujeme - Karl Lagerfeld
programme.desc: „Objavujeme“ je dokumentárny seriál o ikonách hudby a módy, ktoré zmenili svet. Elton John, Queen, John Lennon, Coco Chanel, Dior, Versace či Armani odhaľujú príbehy talentu, odvahy a štýlu, ktorý dodnes inšpiruje generácie.

programme.title: Len peniaze nestačia - Branislav Chrenka
programme.desc: Pediater Branislav Chrenka - Čo dnes potrebujú deti? Choré dieťa chceme čo najrýchlejšie vyliečiť. Zraziť horúčku, posilniť imunitu, nájsť správny liek. Čo ak však niekedy robíme viac, než naše deti potrebujú? A čo ak sa za bolesťou brucha či hlavy skrýva niečo, čo žiadny liek nevyrieši.

programme.title: A King and His Queen
programme.desc: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Most Haunted S16-23: Haden Hill House Part 2
programme.desc: The strange occurrences at Hayden Hill House switch up a gear as whatever is there seems now to be stalking the team with some terrifying results, at least for some of the crew it is proving too much.

programme.title: Most Haunted S16-23: The Old House
programme.desc: This week Yvette Fielding takes her Most Haunted team to Coalville and a house that is surrounded by mystery. The team seem to disturb the rest of some of its long-term residence as they battle through a night of terror.

programme.title: Most Haunted S16-23: Keithley Bus Museum
programme.desc: Once an old foundry, this large old building houses vehicles from a bygone era that are said to still contain passengers whose destination has never ended.

programme.title: Most Haunted S16-23: The Judges Lodgings Part 1
programme.desc: Yvette heads to Presteigne, Mid Wales and the famous Judges Lodgings, were courts were held, people imprisoned and Judges stayed, but it also holds many a secret.

programme.title: Most Haunted S16-23: The Judges Lodgings Part 2
programme.desc: Most Haunted continues its investigation into the Judges Lodgings where the team seem to be under attack and something is trying to get through a door…but what?

programme.title: Most Haunted S16-23: Codnor Castle Part 1
programme.desc: The team venture into a cottage where it is said ‘no living soul can endure living there’. With cursed dolls, murder and suicide this derelict place has everything to fear.

programme.title: Most Haunted S16-23: Codnor Castle Part 2
programme.desc: We stay with the team and find out what happened after we left them last time. The foreboding Codnor Castle Cottage maintains its attack on the Most Haunted team with dramatic effect causing Yvette calls an early end to their night in Hell House.

programme.title: Most Haunted S16-23: Birmingham Central
programme.desc: Yvette takes her team to a disused prison in Birmingham which has housed some of the most notorious criminals in British history.

programme.title: Most Haunted S16-23: Dudley Castle
programme.desc: The ruins that make up Dudley Castle house a plethora of paranormal activity for Yvette and her team to investigate. Strange noises and a violent poltergeist await them as they turn the lights out and do battle with the unseen forces.

programme.title: Most Haunted S16-23: Llanfyliln House Part 1
programme.desc: Workhouses were not the best of places to be, so why would anyone stay after they had died? Yvette takes her team on a memorable journey to find out. For a few team members it was a night they will never forget as they are pushed to the very limits.

programme.title: Most Haunted S16-23: Llanfyliln House Part 2
programme.desc: Whatever was making itself known to the team earlier, continues in this episode as something seems to be following Yvette from the shadows.

programme.title: Most Haunted S16-23: Beaumanor Hall Part 1
programme.desc: Yvette takes the Most Haunted team into the very haunted, disused attic at the top of this huge country mansion and are soon made to feel very unwelcome. Yvette is pushed to the limits and Karl is followed by a very heavily booted phantom.

programme.title: Most Haunted S16-23: Beaumanor Hall Part 1
programme.desc: This time Yvette and her team ventures into the dark abyss of the cellars under this large country house. Without exception every member of the team experience something unexplained as the darkness starts to come to life

programme.title: Most Haunted S16-23: The Moat House Part 1
programme.desc: This time Yvette and her team ventures into the dark abyss of the cellars under this large country house. Without exception every member of the team experience something unexplained as the darkness starts to come to life.

programme.title: Most Haunted S16-23: The Moat House Part 2
programme.desc: Yvette heads to Tamworth and a beautiful manor house that is said to be filled with paranormal occurrences. Almost as soon as the team get there something seems to want to make itself known with dramatic effect

programme.title: Most Haunted
programme.desc: Yvette et son équipe sont appelées dans un bâtiment classé de grade II qui s’étend sur plus de 900 ans pour tenter de découvrir l’activité paranormale mystérieuse qui s'y déroule. Yvette voit quelque chose qui la choque au plus profond d’elle-même.

programme.title: Most Haunted
programme.desc: Yvette Fielding et son équipe relèvent leur plus grand défi à ce jour dans une prison où beaucoup ont perdu la vie et certains semblent être restés. Dans cette partie, l’équipe s’attaque à l’aile 'A' où quelque chose semble les traquer.

programme.title: Most Haunted
programme.desc: La deuxième partie de cette enquête colossale amène l’équipe à la cellule condamnée et à la salle d’exécution. Est-ce un bourreau ou l’une des âmes exécutées qui se manifeste et pousse l’équipe à réévaluer ce qu’elle fait ?
